en-IN.name: Hall Fan Light
en-IN.summary: Control hall fan and light via BLE bridge
en-IN.description: Custom skill for hall fan and chandelier light. Requires Mac BLE bridge polling the command queue.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask center lamp to turn on the fan
Alexa, ask center lamp to turn on the light
Alexa, ask center lamp to switch the light off
